name: image-editor
author: lumine-code
description: View and edit images directly in the editor.
backgroundTips: In the image editor you can crop the picture to the current selection with {{ 'image-editor:crop-to-selection' | keystroke }}

autoSelectTolerance.title: Auto-Select Tolerance
autoSelectTolerance.description: Color difference tolerance for auto-selection (0-255). Lower values require more similar colors to be considered background.

largeImageThreshold.title: Large Image Threshold
largeImageThreshold.description: File size threshold (in MB) for applying optimizations. Images larger than this will use async decoding and compressed history.

maxHistorySize.title: Maximum History Size
maxHistorySize.description: Maximum number of undo/redo states to keep (reduced automatically for large images).

wheelNavigationDelay.title: Mouse Wheel Navigation Delay
wheelNavigationDelay.description: Minimum delay (in milliseconds) between mouse wheel navigation events. Higher values prevent accidental rapid scrolling.

showSuccessMessages.title: Show Success Messages
showSuccessMessages.description: Show success notifications after operations like crop, transform, save, etc.

switchZoomAndNavigation.title: Switch Zoom and Navigation
switchZoomAndNavigation.description: When enabled, scroll wheel navigates and Ctrl+scroll zooms. When disabled, scroll wheel zooms and Ctrl+scroll navigates.

autoZoomLimit.title: Limit Auto Zoom to 100%
autoZoomLimit.description: When enabled, auto zoom (fit to viewport) will not scale images beyond 100%. When disabled, small images will be scaled up to fit the viewport.

scrollCycle.title: Cycle Through Images
scrollCycle.description: When enabled, navigating past the last image wraps to the first image (and vice versa). When disabled, navigation stops at the boundaries.
